::: {#exm-fine-tuning}

#### A smaller learning rate for the reused layers

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
tuned, _ = new_head(train_all=True)
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(
    [
        {"params": tuned[:-1].parameters(), "lr": 0.005},
        {"params": tuned[-1].parameters()},
    ],
    lr=0.05,
    momentum=0.9,
)
group_lrs = [group["lr"] for group in optimizer.param_groups]
print(group_lrs)
```

@sol-fine-tune is [fine-tuning](#def-fine-tuning),
with one [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) for every layer.
A PyTorch optimizer also takes a list of groups of [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
each with its own options [@pytorch_optim].
`optimizer` here would move the reused [convolutional layers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-convolutional-layer) with learning rate `r py$group_lrs[[1]]`
and the new last layer with learning rate `r py$group_lrs[[2]]`.

:::
